tasks.title: Null & Guest Session Enumeration
tasks.description: Attempt to list shares using blank credentials or the guest account.

tasks.title: Automated Share & User Enumeration
tasks.description: Run standard enumeration tools to map out shares, permissions, and domain details.

tasks.title: Connect & Loot Shares
tasks.description: Connect to a specific accessible share. Use 'get' to download files and 'put' to test upload permissions.

tasks.title: Password Spraying & Brute-Force
tasks.description: Use CrackMapExec or NetExec to spray user lists and custom wordlists.

tasks.title: Impacket Command Execution
tasks.description: If you have administrative credentials or NTLM hashes, execute commands or get an interactive SYSTEM shell.

tasks.title: NTLM Relaying & Theft
tasks.description: Generate a malicious payload with ntlm_theft, upload it to a writable share, and catch the hash with Responder or relay it.
